articles.title: Bob Dylan Meets With Pope Leo
articles.description: Pope Leo wore his usual white vestments. Bob Dylan visited the Vatican in a hooded sweatshirt and polka-dot tie. There was no singing.

articles.title: Secondary school teacher to crofter - life on the UK's most remote island

articles.title: Finland Sends 2 Men to Prison for Damaging Undersea Cable in Baltic Sea
